STATUS
------
Free mode is now playable from start to finish. The full economic loop works:
restaurants, staff, pizzas, competitors. The surrounding systems are running
now too: random staff events, mayor award ceremonies, police and mafia
interactions, pizza competitions, and all the financial and market research
screens. You get points, you can get a high score and you can go bust. You can
even win!

See https://pizzalegacy.nl/ for details on the current status.

Find the full README online:
https://codeberg.org/cowomaly/pizzalegacy/src/branch/main/README.md
